title: Moment defects and sharp iid Berry–Esseen bounds
summary: Starting from Shevtsova’s sharp third-moment inequality, we develop an exact defect from the standardized two-point family and derive quantitative transport and characteristic-function bounds. A penalized extremal problem yields eventual two-point optimality, \(C_n=C_Q^*(n)<C_{\mathrm E}\), together with a uniform linear deficit and sharp cubic Wasserstein stability. A fifth-order lattice saddle-point expansion gives the full oscillatory \(n^{-2}\) correction to the optimal constants.
